rationale: Reconciles exactly to the certified fixed-lot baseline (190/190 trades, identical R statistics) -- proves percent-equity sizing is R-neutral when volume resolution is sufficient, carries forward SweepReclaim's existing D028 portfolio-validated status unchanged.

Passes every Phase 3 standalone decision-rule gate and offers a genuine, non-outlier-driven 18.3% drawdown improvement -- but fails the actual Phase 4 portfolio test (does not exceed matched core on cumulative R). An interesting, real standalone finding that does not translate to a portfolio recommendation, exactly analogous to D027's own SweepReclaim RESEARCH_ONLY verdict and D028's SR5.

Fails three explicit anti-overfitting gates simultaneously (top-3/top-5/best-quarter removal all flip the result negative) -- extreme runner-subgroup dependence, now observed with a genuinely working partial-close mechanism, not a testing artifact.
